2608.30865.title: Predicting Residential Rents in Dakar Using Machine Learning
2608.30865.paper_summary: Dakar's residential rental market remains poorly documented despite its economic and social importance: 54.4% of households are renters, compared to 23.3% nationally. This study develops a complete machine learning pipeline to predict residential rents in Dakar, from data collection to model interpretation. An original dataset of 1,507 rental listings was built through systematic web scraping and a documented cleaning pipeline, then enriched with four purpose-built features, including a luxury score and a keyword-based quality score. Five models were compared: linear regression, Random Forest (baseline), XGBoost, and LightGBM optimized through Bayesian optimization with Optuna, using leakage-free KFold target encoding for location. The optimized XGBoost model achieved the best performance with an $R^2$ of 0.847, an MAE of 210,902 XOF, and an RMSE of 324,195 XOF. Feature importance was assessed using native XGBoost gain and SHAP values, revealing a substantial difference in the ranking of location, which appears as a minor predictor by gain but as the second most influential variable by SHAP. This result carries methodological implications for hedonic studies using target-encoded categorical variables. This study provides an interpretable benchmark for Dakar's rental market and highlights several avenues for improvement, including the integration of geospatial features and conformal prediction.
2608.30865.paper_summary_zh: 達卡的住宅租賃市場儘管在經濟和社會上具有重要性，但仍然缺乏充分的文獻記錄：54.4%的家庭是租戶，而全國的比例為23.3%。本研究開發了一個完整的機器學習流程，以預測達卡的住宅租金，從數據收集到模型解釋。通過系統性的網頁抓取和記錄的清理流程，建立了一個包含1,507條租賃列表的原始數據集，然後通過四個專門設計的特徵進行豐富，包括奢侈分數和基於關鍵字的質量分數。比較了五個模型：線性回歸、隨機森林（基線）、XGBoost和LightGBM，通過貝葉斯優化與Optuna進行優化，並使用無泄漏的KFold目標編碼來處理位置。經過優化的XGBoost模型達到了最佳性能，$R^2$為0.847，MAE為210,902 XOF，RMSE為324,195 XOF。使用本地XGBoost增益和SHAP值評估了特徵的重要性，顯示位置的排名存在顯著差異，根據增益看似是一個次要預測因子，但根據SHAP則是第二個最具影響力的變量。這一結果對於使用目標編碼類別變量的享樂研究具有方法論意義。本研究為達卡的租賃市場提供了一個可解釋的基準，並突顯了幾個改進的途徑，包括整合地理空間特徵和符合預測。
